scope.purpose: Remove the measured collection bottlenecks with bounded pilots while keeping formal 70k paused

execution_plan.task: Measure episode, writer, and import-stage timing
execution_plan.completion_gate: Reports expose per-family/per-severity collection time, writer commit time, metadata refresh time, and throughput

execution_plan.task: Cache planning-tick route geometry and background predictions
execution_plan.completion_gate: Exact lane-chain geometry and exact background prediction time grids are reused only within one unchanged planning state
Episodes remain atomic and ordered while manifests are materialized once per collected batch

execution_plan.task: Remove eager training-only package imports from collection startup
execution_plan.completion_gate: Sensorless collector import does not load pytorch_lightning, torchmetrics, or TransfuserAgent

execution_plan.task: Run isolated adjacent-lane and on-ramp pilots
execution_plan.completion_gate: Both pilots commit native data, pass Diffusion verification and RiskEntry v2 preflight, and preserve frozen semantics
Separate user-authorized long-running operation after this code is reviewed and frozen

root_cause.primary: Normal planner full-horizon audit repeatedly rebuilt identical route-chain geometry and recomputed identical background predictions for roles, candidates, and ranked proposals in the same physical planning tick.
root_cause.secondary: The parent writer reread episode metadata and regenerated all manifests after every episode instead of once per ordered batch.
root_cause.tertiary: Every isolated spawn process eagerly imported training-only Lightning/TorchMetrics code through package __init__ modules.

planner.cache_keys: exact lane objects/start s-d/seam geometry and exact float64 prediction time grid

on_ramp_external_merge.previous_observation: one serial episode remained CPU-bound for more than 240 seconds

tests.deselected: known sandbox multi-worker DataLoader test; previously passed independently

residual_bottlenecks.evidence: Cold collector import remains about 3.23s and 709MB because MetaDrive/torch are still required by the environment contract.
residual_bottlenecks.decision: Keep spawn-per-episode determinism for this round; process pooling or forkserver preloading requires a separate reproducibility round.

residual_bottlenecks.evidence: Episode collection remains CPU-bound, but bounded four-pair concurrency now scales across cores.
residual_bottlenecks.decision: Use four workers for the existing formal host; do not add nested candidate-level multiprocessing.

residual_bottlenecks.evidence: Batching reduces refresh frequency but each refresh still scans accumulated episode metadata.
residual_bottlenecks.decision: Monitor writer_timing during resume and stop if its fraction grows materially; do not change storage schema during collection.

verdict.next_action: Review and freeze this code, then resume the existing formal root as a separate four-worker operation with per-family and writer timing monitoring.
